name: Pyromancer Lighting the Fuse adds Intellect-based spell crit rating (#681)
contract: #681: Lighting the Fuse raises spell crit rating by 15% of Intellect. The Blaze tick half of the tooltip is NOT asserted: AscensionPyromancerAuras.cpp forces Blaze's periodic crit chance to 0 unless Next-Blaze-crit or 520770 applies, so it is a maintainer decision (see PR).
